name: Trimmed constants and tail
description: The baseline architecture with hand-written adders. Each round constant is reduced by a few units to gain trailing zeros, which a constant adder skips, and free carry-ins on the neighbouring additions make up the difference. Two additions in a row into one register share their lowest bit, saving a Toffoli. The last two schedule words are never stored: their terms are added straight into the state. Saves 649 Toffolis and 2 qubits over the folded first rounds.
